package.name: tracked_vehicle_mlp_teleop
package.description: ROS 1 Noetic / Gazebo 11 tracked ground vehicle physical simulation. Keyboard teleoperation with an optional PyTorch MLP slip/slope compensation controller, multi-scene evaluation (flat, 10-degree slope, low friction) and CSV/GIF demo tooling. The MLP is trained by behaviour cloning from a PI expert and runs as the final feedback controller.
